sentences.text: The Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Maandhan Yojana (PMSSNTDT) is a government welfare scheme aimed at providing social security to unorganized workers.
The objective of the scheme is to provide a monthly pension to workers in the unorganized sector after they reach the age of 60 years.
The benefits include a monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 for eligible beneficiaries.
Eligibility criteria include being an unorganized worker aged between 18 to 40 years.
The applicant must have a monthly income of less than Rs. 15,000.
The application process involves registering through the official portal or designated centers.
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Labour and Employment.
The pension is disbursed monthly after the beneficiary reaches the age of 60.
Additional details regarding the scheme may include provisions for family pension in case of the beneficiary's demise.
